propositions: A required `--class` parameter accepting a bounded enum must replace the validated-then-discarded free-text `--reason` in bug close transitions.
The `close_class` enum value must be written to `status_data` at transition time and folded into reduced ticket state so it persists and is queryable via `rebar show`.

The enum validation guard at `txn.bug_close_reason_ok()` (line ~221-232) and the precheck guard in `transition_close._completion_precheck()` (line ~121) must both be updated to validate `--class` instead of `--reason`.
Omitting `--class` on a bug close must exit nonzero with an error message that names at least one allowed enum value.
An invalid `close_class` value outside the enum vocabulary must be rejected with a nonzero exit.
